Silver Nitrate Applicator Sticks for B2B Buyers

AGNAVELIS applicator sticks combine 75% silver nitrate and 25% potassium nitrate on a rigid wooden shaft. Manufactured in Türkiye for professional healthcare supply channels.

For medical device distributors, hospital and clinic suppliers, healthcare wholesalers and importers. Professional use only — not for consumer sale.

Product at a Glance

AGNAVELIS Silver Nitrate Applicator Sticks are non-sterile, single-use applicators with a treated tip, intended for controlled, localised chemical cauterisation of small, clearly defined superficial tissue areas by trained healthcare professionals.

Composition
75% silver nitrate / 25% potassium nitrate
Applicator shaft
Rigid wooden shaft
Sterility
Non-sterile
Reuse
Single use only
Device status
Medical device, Class I
Country of manufacture
Türkiye

Full specifications, intended purpose and warnings are listed on the silver nitrate applicator sticks product page.

Designed for Professional Supply Channels

AGNAVELIS is supplied business-to-business only. The product is intended for trained healthcare professionals, and this website does not offer consumer sales, pricing or online ordering.

Medical device distributors

National and regional distributors building a wound care, stoma care or minor procedure portfolio.

Hospital and clinic suppliers

Suppliers serving hospital procurement, outpatient clinics and specialist departments.

Healthcare wholesalers

Wholesale operations supplying pharmacies, clinics and medical retailers within their market.

Importers

Importers who handle product registration and customs clearance in their destination country.

Why AGNAVELIS

Each point below reflects the product as documented on the label, in the brochure and in the current Instructions for Use.

Defined 75/25 formulation

Every applicator tip carries a 75% silver nitrate and 25% potassium nitrate formulation, stated consistently on the label, in the brochure and in the Instructions for Use.

Rigid wooden shaft

Rigid wooden shaft designed to support controlled and precise placement of the treated tip during application.

Professional supply positioning

Supplied for professional use only, with clear non-sterile and single-use status so procurement teams can assess suitability without ambiguity.

Documentation with the product

A bilingual English and Turkish Instructions for Use document (IFU-AGN-00, Rev. 00) accompanies the product and is published on this website.

Direct manufacturer contact

Enquiries are answered by the manufacturer in Türkiye, without an intermediary between the buyer and the production source.

ISO 15223-1 label symbols

Label symbols follow ISO 15223-1 for the information supplied by the manufacturer, supporting review by importers and regulatory teams.
